description:
Search for active offers in the AnyGett database.

Returns a JSON array of matching offers with all fields parsed.
Returns an empty array if no offers match.

FILTERS (all optional):
- query: full-text search in title + description
- offer_type: "product" | "service" | "job" | "resume"
- category_id: get valid IDs from list_categories
- price_min / price_max: filter by price range (uses price_min field of offers)
- currency: ISO 4217 code, e.g. "USD", "EUR"
- limit: 1–50 results (default 10)

category_id.description: Category ID to filter by. Get valid IDs from list_categories tool first.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–50, default 10)

price_max.description: Maximum price filter (inclusive, matches against offer's price_min)

query.description: Keyword to match offer title or description

name: search_offers
